15 minutes of a small plant: SCADA polls a PV inverter, an energy meter and a battery gateway (units 1–3); an HMI writes setpoints; device identification at the start; the meter rejects one block (illegal data address); battery unit 3 stops answering for a minute and its gateway then reports it unreachable; the meter resets its connection once; a few retransmissions.
The plant trace compressed with gzip (decompressed into the cache while open).
Classic pcap: a Modbus/TCP-to-RTU gateway with eight units, polled round-robin for coils, discrete inputs and registers; units 6 and 8 are not connected (gateway exceptions 0x0A and 0x0B).

The demo and screenshot trace: 10 minutes of a site with the usual problems. SCADA polls a PV inverter, a battery and four energy meters behind a Modbus/TCP-to-RTU gateway; an EMS polls the inverter's block again every 250 ms (duplicate polling); the gateway's meters answer in 90 to 400 ms and meter 4 is offline (exception 0x0B after the gateway's 1 s timeout), so the SCADA's 1 s cycle stretches to about 1.5 s; meter 2 misses a poll now and then; SCADA reads the battery at 40001 (a 4x-offset mistake, illegal data address); an HMI writes the battery's setpoint every two minutes, once out of range (illegal data value); the EMS resets its connection once; one retransmission.
